'''Sutloo''' was the owner and operator of [[Sutloo's Trading Post]] on [[Seregar]]. He was an older, pot-bellied man who was one of the original settlers on Seregar. He made a meager living but was happy with his life. He enjoyed meeting new people and lived very simply.
